main_text.p: lere non uenerít. exposita simul bre ui fidei suæ confessione. Exemplar epistolæ sic habet.
main_text.head: EPISTOLA I. VVICLEVI AD Vrbanum 6. pp. missa an. 1384.
main_text.p: GAVDEO PLANE DETEGEre cuicunqʒ fidem meam quàm teneo, & specialiter Rom. pontifici. Quia suppono, quòd sit orthodoxa, ipse fidem meam humiliter confirmabit, & si sit erronea emendabit. Suppono autem, quòd euangelium Christi sit corpus legis Dei. Christũ autem, qui euangelium illud immediate dederat, credo esse uerum Deum, & uerum hominem, & in hoc, legem euangelij omnes partes scripturæ aliàs excedentem. Suppono iterum, quod Rom. pontifex cum sum mus Christi uicarius in terris sit, ad illam legem euangelij inter uiantes maximè obligatus. Maioritas enim

page.notes: The heading "GAVDEO" is a large initial G; the running head is in small capitals, transcribed from the scan. Long s rendered as s. Possible misreadings: "sum mus" (printed with a space), "sit,ad" as printed. The final "E" is a signature mark at the foot, not text, and is given as a signature.
